# RePub - Erasmus University Repository

> > Institutional repository of Erasmus University Rotterdam providing open access to research publications from Erasmus MC, Rotterdam School of Management, and other faculties across biomedical sciences, social sciences, and economics.

RePub serves as the digital archive for scholarly output from Erasmus University Rotterdam and its affiliated institutions, particularly Erasmus MC: University Medical Center Rotterdam. The repository contains peer-reviewed articles, dissertations, and research data spanning molecular biology, clinical medicine, psychology, economics, and social sciences.

## Key Topics

- Erasmus MC: University Medical Center Rotterdam
- Molecular biology and genetics
- Clinical epidemiology
- Aging and neuroscience
- HIV integrase and retroviral research
- Cancer research and oncology
- Organizational psychology
- Health economics
- COPD and respiratory medicine
- Cardiovascular disease
- Infectious disease surveillance
- Genetic mutation analysis
- Work engagement and job crafting
- Financial markets and institutional investors
- Public health interventions

## Biomedical and Clinical Research

- [Hearing impairment is associated with smaller brain volume in aging](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/97847): MRI study linking hearing loss to brain volume in elderly by Rigters et al
- [MEK inhibition is a promising therapeutic strategy for MLL-rearranged infant acute lymphoblastic leukemia patients carrying RAS mutations](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/98211): MEK inhibitor therapy study for infant ALL with RAS mutations by Kerstjens
- [ADAM17 and EGFR regulate IL-6 receptor and amphiregulin mRNA expression in COPD](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/96040): COPD cell signaling study on ADAM17/EGFR by Stolarczyk et al
- [Measures of bioavailable serum testosterone and estradiol and their relationships with muscle strength, bone density, and body composition in elderly men](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/9465): Hormone-health relationships in elderly men by van den Beld & de Jong
- [Detection of genetic prognostic markers in uveal melanoma biopsies using fluorescence in situ hybridization](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/9847): FISH-based prognostic markers for uveal melanoma by Naus et al
- [Dementia and death: Separate sides of the atrial fibrillation coin?](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/94894): Atrial fibrillation, dementia & mortality study by Wolters & Ikram
- [Comparison between children and adolescents with and without chronic benign pain: consultation rate and pain characteristics](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/9907): Pediatric chronic pain consultation study by Perquin & Hunfeld
- [Bright light therapy in pregnant women with major depressive disorder: Study protocol for a randomized, double-blind, controlled clinical trial](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/94213): Light therapy RCT protocol for antepartum depression by Bais et al
- [Statin use decreases coagulation in users of vitamin K antagonists](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/97196): Statin-VKA drug interaction study by van Rein et al

## Molecular Biology and Genetics

- [Complementation between HIV integrase proteins mutated in different domains](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/9487): Research on HIV integrase protein complementation by van Gent & Vink
- [Macrophage production and activation are dependent on TRIM33](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/97870): TRIM33 role in macrophage differentiation research by Gallouet et al
- [Development of a quantitative real-time detection assay for hepatitis B virus DNA and comparison with two commercial assays](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/9431): HBV DNA quantification assay development by Pas, Fries & Niesters
- [Knockout mouse model for Fxr2: a model for mental retardation](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/9866): Fxr2 knockout mouse model for mental retardation research
- [Cloning of a human homolog of the yeast nucleotide excision repair gene MMS19 and interaction with transcription repair factor TFIIH via the XPB and XPD helicases](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/9531): Human MMS19 gene cloning & TFIIH interaction study

## Public Health and Epidemiology

- [Follow-up of contacts of middle east respiratory syndrome coronavirus–infected returning travelers, the Netherlands, 2014](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/94613): MERS-CoV contact tracing study in Netherlands, 2014

## Psychology and Organizational Behavior

- [Job crafting and its impact on work engagement and job satisfaction in mining and manufacturing](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/96004): Job crafting study by De Beer, Tims & Bakker in mining/manufacturing
- [Evidence for long-term cross-language repetition priming in conceptual implicit memory tasks](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/961): Bilingual memory research by Zeelenberg & Pecher on cross-language priming

## Economics and Social Sciences

- [Institutional investors and home bias in Europe's Capital Markets Union](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/98431): Home bias analysis in EU capital markets by Schoenmaker & Darvas
- [Analyzing and improving the energy balancing market in the power trading agent competition](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/99291): Energy market simulation analysis by Ansarin, Ketter & Collins
- [How people organise cultural attitudes: cultural belief systems and the populist radical right](https://repub.eur.nl/pub/97890): Cultural belief systems & populism study by Daenekindt et al
